noability.name: Noability
noability.desc: This Pokémon does not possess an ability and gains no special effects from one.

adaptability.name: Adaptability
adaptability.shortDesc: Increases the same-type attack bonus from 1.5× to 2×.

aerilate.name: Aerilate
aerilate.shortDesc: Turns the bearer's []{type:normal} moves into []{type:flying} moves and strengthens them to 1.3× their power.
aerilate.desc: Turns the bearer's []{type:normal}-type moves into []{type:flying}-type moves. Moves changed by this ability have 1.3× their power.

aftermath.name: Aftermath
aftermath.shortDesc: Damages the attacker for 1/4 its max HP when knocked out by a contact move.
aftermath.desc: When this Pokémon is knocked out by a move that makes contact, the move's user takes 1/4 its maximum HP in damage.

airlock.name: Airlock
airlock.shortDesc: Negates all effects of weather, but does not prevent the weather itself.
airlock.desc: While this Pokémon is in battle, weather can still be in play, but will not have any of its effects. This ability functions identically to []{ability:cloud-nine}.

analytic.name: Analytic
analytic.shortDesc: Strengthens moves to 1.3× their power when moving last.
analytic.desc: This Pokémon's moves have 1.3× their power when it moves last in a turn. []{move:future-sight} and []{move:doom-desire} are unaffected.

angerpoint.name: Angerpoint
angerpoint.shortDesc: Raises Attack to the maximum of six stages upon receiving a critical hit.
angerpoint.desc: Whenever this Pokémon receives a critical hit, its Attack rises to the maximum of 6 stages. This ability will still take effect if the critical hit is received by a []{move:substitute}.

angershell.name: Angershell
angershell.shortDesc: At half HP, the Pokémon lowers its Def and Sp. Def but sharply boosts its Atk, Sp. Atk, and Speed.
angershell.desc: At half HP, the Pokémon lowers its Def and Sp. Def but sharply boosts its Atk, Sp. Atk, and Speed.

anticipation.name: Anticipation
anticipation.shortDesc: Notifies all trainers upon entering battle if an opponent has a super-effective move, []{move:self-destruct}, []{move:explosion}, or a one-hit KO move.
anticipation.desc: When this Pokémon enters battle, if one of its opponents has a move that is super effective against it, []{move:self-destruct}, []{move:explosion}, or a one-hit knockout move, all participating trainers are notified. The move itself is not revealed; only that there is such a move. Moves that inflict typeless damage, such as []{move:future-sight}, and moves of variable type, such as []{move:hidden-power}, count as their listed types. []{move:counter}, []{move:metal-burst}, []{move:mirror-coat}, and one-hit KO moves to which this Pokémon is immune do not trigger this ability.

arenatrap.name: Arenatrap
arenatrap.shortDesc: Prevents opponents from fleeing or switching out. Eluded by []{type:flying}-types and Pokémon in the air.
arenatrap.desc: While this Pokémon is in battle, opposing Pokémon cannot flee or switch out. []{type:flying}-type Pokémon and Pokémon in the air, e.g. due to []{ability:levitate} or []{move:magnet-rise}, are unaffected. Pokémon with []{ability:run-away} can still flee. Pokémon can still switch out with the use of a move or item. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is doubled.

armortail.name: Armortail
armortail.shortDesc: The curious tail protects allies from opposing priority moves.
armortail.desc: The curious tail protects allies from opposing priority moves.

flags.name: Flags
flags.shortDesc: Placeholder ability with no battle effect.
flags.desc: A placeholder ability used for debugging; it has no effect in battle.

aromaveil.name: Aromaveil
aromaveil.shortDesc: Protects allies against moves that affect their mental state.
aromaveil.desc: Protects allies against moves that affect their mental state.

asoneglastrier.name: Asoneglastrier
asoneglastrier.desc: Opposing Pokémon cannot consume held Berries. When this Pokémon knocks out another Pokémon, its Attack stat rises by one stage (effects of Unnerve and Chilling Neigh).

asonespectrier.name: Asonespectrier
asonespectrier.desc: Opposing Pokémon cannot consume held Berries. When this Pokémon knocks out another Pokémon, its Special Attack stat rises by one stage (effects of Unnerve and Grim Neigh).

aurabreak.name: Aurabreak
aurabreak.shortDesc: Makes []{ability:dark-aura} and []{ability:fairy-aura} weaken moves of their respective types.
aurabreak.desc: While this Pokémon is on the field, []{ability:dark-aura} and []{ability:fairy-aura} weaken moves of their respective types to 2/3 their power, rather than strengthening them.

baddreams.name: Baddreams
baddreams.shortDesc: Damages sleeping opponents for 1/8 their max HP after each turn.
baddreams.desc: Opposing Pokémon take 1/8 of their maximum HP in damage after each turn while they are asleep.

ballfetch.name: Ballfetch
ballfetch.shortDesc: If the Pokémon is not holding an item, it will fetch the Poké Ball from the first failed throw of the battle.
ballfetch.desc: At any time after the first Poké Ball is thrown and fails to catch a Pokémon, at the end of a turn, if a Pokémon with Ball Fetch is on the field and not holding another item, it will pick up the same type of ball as the first one thrown.

battery.name: Battery
battery.shortDesc: Ally Pokémon's moves have their power increased to 1.3×.
battery.desc: Ally Pokémon's moves have their power increased to 1.3×.

battlearmor.name: Battlearmor
battlearmor.desc: Protects the Pokemon from critical hits.

battlebond.name: Battlebond
battlebond.shortDesc: Transforms this Pokémon into Ash-Greninja after fainting an opponent. Water Shuriken's power is 20 and always hits three times.
battlebond.desc: Transforms this Pokémon into Ash-Greninja after fainting an opponent. Water Shuriken's power is 20 and always hits three times. This ability cannot be copied or replaced. This ability only takes effect for Greninja.

beadsofruin.name: Beadsofruin
beadsofruin.shortDesc: Lowers the Sp. Def of all opposing Pokémon.
beadsofruin.desc: Lowers the Sp. Def of all opposing Pokémon.

beastboost.name: Beastboost
beastboost.shortDesc: Raises this Pokémon's highest stat by one stage when it faints another Pokémon.
beastboost.desc: Raises this Pokémon's highest stat by one stage when it faints another Pokémon.

berserk.name: Berserk
berserk.shortDesc: Raises this Pokémon's Special Attack by one stage every time its HP drops below half.
berserk.desc: Whenever this Pokémon takes damage from a move that causes its HP to drop below 50%, its Special Attack rises by one stage.

bigpecks.name: Bigpecks
bigpecks.desc: This Pokémon's Defense cannot be lowered by other Pokémon. This Pokémon can still be passed negative Defense modifiers through []{move:heart-swap} or []{move:guard-swap}.

blaze.name: Blaze
blaze.shortDesc: Strengthens []{type:fire} moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
blaze.desc: When HP is below 1/3, Fire-type moves have 1.5x power.

bulletproof.name: Bulletproof
bulletproof.shortDesc: Protects against bullet, ball, and bomb-based moves.
bulletproof.desc: Protects against bullet, ball, and bomb-based moves.

cheekpouch.name: Cheekpouch
cheekpouch.shortDesc: Restores HP upon eating a Berry, in addition to the Berry's effect.
cheekpouch.desc: Restores HP upon eating a Berry, in addition to the Berry's effect.

chillingneigh.name: Chillingneigh
chillingneigh.shortDesc: Boosts Attack after knocking out a Pokémon.
chillingneigh.desc: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a chilling neigh, which boosts its Attack stat.

clearbody.name: Clearbody
clearbody.shortDesc: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.
clearbody.desc: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stats.

cloudnine.name: Cloudnine
cloudnine.shortDesc: Negates all effects of weather, but does not prevent the weather itself.
cloudnine.desc: While this Pokémon is in battle, weather can still be in play, but will not have any of its effects. This ability functions identically to []{ability:air-lock}.

colorchange.name: Colorchange
colorchange.shortDesc: Changes type to match when hit by a damaging move.
colorchange.desc: Whenever this Pokémon takes damage from a move, the Pokémon's type changes to match the move. If the Pokémon has two types, both are overridden. The Pokémon must directly take damage; for example, moves blocked by a []{move:substitute} will not trigger this ability, nor will moves that deal damage indirectly, such as []{move:spikes}. This ability takes effect on only the last hit of a multiple-hit attack. In Pokémon Colosseum and XD: Gale of Darkness, this ability does not take effect on Shadow-type moves.

comatose.name: Comatose
comatose.shortDesc: This Pokémon always acts as though it were Asleep.
comatose.desc: This Pokémon always acts as though it were Asleep. It cannot be given another status ailment; it's unaffected by []{move:yawn}; it can use []{move:sleep-talk}; and so on.

commander.name: Commander
commander.shortDesc: If this Pokémon's ally is Dondozo, it enters Dondozo's mouth to command it, boosting Dondozo instead of acting.
commander.desc: If this Pokémon's ally is Dondozo, it enters Dondozo's mouth to command it, boosting Dondozo instead of acting.

competitive.name: Competitive
competitive.shortDesc: Raises Special Attack by two stages upon having any stat lowered.
competitive.desc: When a stat is lowered by an opponent, raises Sp. Attack by 2 stages.

contrary.name: Contrary
contrary.desc: Whenever this Pokémon's stats would be raised, they are instead lowered by the same amount, and vice versa.

corrosion.name: Corrosion
corrosion.shortDesc: This Pokémon can inflict poison on Poison and Steel Pokémon.
corrosion.desc: This Pokémon's moves and item ignore the usual immunity of Poison and Steel Pokémon when attempting to inflict poison.

costar.name: Costar
costar.shortDesc: Copies an ally's stat changes when the Pokémon enters battle.
costar.desc: Copies an ally's stat changes when the Pokémon enters battle.

cottondown.name: Cottondown
cottondown.shortDesc: When Ignores moves and abilities that draw in moves.
cottondown.desc: When the Pokémon is hit by an attack, it scatters cotton fluff around and lowers the Speed stats of all Pokémon except itself.

cudchew.name: Cudchew
cudchew.shortDesc: After eating a Berry, the Pokémon will eat it again at the end of the next turn.
cudchew.desc: After eating a Berry, the Pokémon will eat it again at the end of the next turn.

curiousmedicine.name: Curiousmedicine
curiousmedicine.shortDesc: Resets all stat changes upon entering battlefield.
curiousmedicine.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it scatters medicine from its shell, which removes all stat changes from allies.

cursedbody.name: Cursedbody
cursedbody.shortDesc: Has a 30% chance of Disabling any move that hits the Pokémon.
cursedbody.desc: Moves that hit this Pokémon have a 30% chance of being Disabled afterward.

cutecharm.name: Cutecharm
cutecharm.shortDesc: Has a 30% chance of infatuating attacking Pokémon on contact.
cutecharm.desc: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being infatuated. Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, any wild Pokémon whose species can be either gender has a 2/3 chance of being set to the opposite gender, and a 1/3 chance of having a random gender as usual.

damp.name: Damp
damp.shortDesc: Prevents []{move:self-destruct}, []{move:explosion}, and []{ability:aftermath} from working while the Pokémon is in battle.
damp.desc: While this Pokémon is in battle, []{move:self-destruct} and []{move:explosion} will fail and []{ability:aftermath} will not take effect.

dancer.name: Dancer
dancer.shortDesc: Whenever another Pokémon uses a dance move, this Pokémon will use the same move immediately afterwards.
dancer.desc: Whenever another Pokémon uses a dance move, this Pokémon will use the same move immediately afterwards.

darkaura.name: Darkaura
darkaura.shortDesc: Strengthens []{type:dark} moves to 1.33× their power for all friendly and opposing Pokémon.
darkaura.desc: Strengthens []{type:dark} moves for all friendly and opposing Pokémon.

dauntlessshield.name: Dauntlessshield
dauntlessshield.desc: Boosts the Pokémon’s Defense stat the first time the Pokémon enters a battle.

dazzling.name: Dazzling
dazzling.shortDesc: Opposing Pokémon cannot use priority attacks.
dazzling.desc: When an opposing Pokémon attempts to use a move that targets this Pokémon or an ally, and that move has priority, it will fail.

defeatist.name: Defeatist
defeatist.shortDesc: Halves Attack and Special Attack at 50% max HP or less.
defeatist.desc: This Pokémon's Attack and Special Attack are halved when it has half its HP or less.

defiant.name: Defiant
defiant.shortDesc: Raises Attack two stages upon having any stat lowered.
defiant.desc: When a stat is lowered by an opponent, raises Attack by 2 stages.

deltastream.name: Deltastream
deltastream.shortDesc: Creates a mysterious air current, which cannot be replaced and causes moves to never be super effective against Flying Pokémon.
deltastream.desc: When this Pokémon enters battle or gains this ability, the weather becomes a mysterious air current. A mysterious air current causes moves to not be super effective against Flying; they do neutral damage instead. []{ability:anticipation} and []{move:stealth-rock} are not affected. The mysterious air current ends when this Pokémon leaves battle or loses this ability, or when this ability is nullified. The weather cannot otherwise be changed except by the effects of []{ability:desolate-land} and []{ability:primordial-sea}. []{ability:air-lock} and []{ability:cloud-nine} will prevent the effect of a mysterious air current, but will not allow the weather to be changed.

desolateland.name: Desolateland
desolateland.shortDesc: Creates extremely harsh sunlight, which has all the properties of Sunny Day, cannot be replaced, and causes damaging Water moves to fail.
desolateland.desc: When this Pokémon enters battle or gains this ability, the weather becomes extremely harsh sunlight. Extremely harsh sunlight has all the properties of []{move:sunny-day} and also causes damaging Water moves to fail. Extremely harsh sunlight ends when this Pokémon leaves battle or loses this ability, or when this ability is nullified. The weather cannot otherwise be changed except by the effects of []{ability:delta-stream} and []{ability:primordial-sea}. []{ability:air-lock} and []{ability:cloud-nine} will prevent the effects of extremely harsh sunlight, including allowing Water moves to work, but will not allow the weather to be changed.

disguise.name: Disguise
disguise.shortDesc: Prevents the first instance of battle damage.
disguise.desc: Blocks the first damaging move, taking 1/8 max HP as damage instead.

download.name: Download
download.shortDesc: Raises the attack stat corresponding to the opponents' weaker defense one stage upon entering battle.
download.desc: On switch-in, raises Attack or Sp. Attack by 1 stage based on opponent's lower defense.

dragonsmaw.name: Dragonsmaw
dragonsmaw.desc: Increases the power of Dragon-type moves used by this Pokémon by 50%.

drizzle.name: Drizzle
drizzle.shortDesc: Summons rain that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.
drizzle.desc: On switch-in, the weather becomes rainy for 5 turns.

drought.name: Drought
drought.shortDesc: Summons strong sunlight that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.
drought.desc: On switch-in, the weather becomes sunny for 5 turns.

dryskin.name: Dryskin
dryskin.shortDesc: Causes 1/8 max HP in damage each turn during strong sunlight, but heals for 1/8 max HP during rain. Increases damage from []{type:fire} moves to 1.25×, but absorbs []{type:water} moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.
dryskin.desc: Heals 1/8 HP in rain, loses 1/8 HP in sun.

earlybird.name: Earlybird
earlybird.shortDesc: Makes sleep pass twice as quickly.
earlybird.desc: This Pokémon's remaining sleep turn count falls by 2 rather than 1. If this Pokémon's sleep counter is at 1, it will fall to 0 and then the Pokémon will wake up.

eartheater.name: Eartheater
eartheater.shortDesc: Restores HP if hit by a Ground-type move, instead of taking damage.
eartheater.desc: Restores HP if hit by a Ground-type move, instead of taking damage.

effectspore.name: Effectspore
effectspore.shortDesc: Has a 30% chance of inflcting either paralysis, poison, or sleep on attacking Pokémon on contact.
effectspore.desc: 30% chance to poison, paralyze, or sleep attackers that make contact.

electricsurge.name: Electricsurge
electricsurge.shortDesc: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Electric Terrain.
electricsurge.desc: On switch-in, the terrain becomes Electric Terrain for 5 turns.

electromorphosis.name: Electromorphosis
electromorphosis.shortDesc: The Pokémon becomes charged when hit by an attack, boosting the power of its next Electric move.
electromorphosis.desc: The Pokémon becomes charged when hit by an attack, boosting the power of its next Electric move.

embodyaspectcornerstone.name: Embodyaspectcornerstone
embodyaspectcornerstone.shortDesc: When the Pokémon enters battle, it terastallizes and its Defense is boosted.
embodyaspectcornerstone.desc: When the Pokémon enters battle, it terastallizes and its Defense is boosted.

embodyaspecthearthflame.name: Embodyaspecthearthflame
embodyaspecthearthflame.shortDesc: When the Pokémon enters battle, it terastallizes and its Attack is boosted.
embodyaspecthearthflame.desc: When the Pokémon enters battle, it terastallizes and its Attack is boosted.

embodyaspectteal.name: Embodyaspectteal
embodyaspectteal.shortDesc: When the Pokémon enters battle, it terastallizes and its Speed is boosted.
embodyaspectteal.desc: When the Pokémon enters battle, it terastallizes and its Speed is boosted.

embodyaspectwellspring.name: Embodyaspectwellspring
embodyaspectwellspring.shortDesc: When the Pokémon enters battle, it terastallizes and its Sp. Def is boosted.
embodyaspectwellspring.desc: When the Pokémon enters battle, it terastallizes and its Sp. Def is boosted.

emergencyexit.name: Emergency Exit
emergencyexit.shortDesc: Switches out when HP is 50% or less after taking damage.
emergencyexit.desc: When this Pokémon's HP falls to 50% or less from damage, it immediately attempts to switch out if a replacement is available.

fairyaura.name: Fairyaura
fairyaura.shortDesc: Strengthens []{type:fairy} moves to 1.33× their power for all friendly and opposing Pokémon.
fairyaura.desc: Strengthens []{type:fairy} moves for all friendly and opposing Pokémon.

filter.name: Filter
filter.shortDesc: Decreases damage taken from super-effective moves by 1/4.
filter.desc: Reduces damage from super-effective moves by 25%.

flamebody.name: Flamebody
flamebody.shortDesc: Has a 30% chance of burning attacking Pokémon on contact.
flamebody.desc: 30% chance to burn attackers that make contact.

flareboost.name: Flareboost
flareboost.shortDesc: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× when burned.
flareboost.desc: This Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack when burned.

flashfire.name: Flashfire
flashfire.shortDesc: Protects against []{type:fire} moves. Once one has been blocked, the Pokémon's own Fire moves inflict 1.5× damage until it leaves battle.
flashfire.desc: Grants immunity to Fire-type moves. When hit by Fire moves, boosts Fire-type move power by 50%.

condition.name: Condition
condition.shortDesc: Placeholder ability with no battle effect.
condition.desc: An internal placeholder ability used for conditional scripting with no in-battle effect.

flowergift.name: Flowergift
flowergift.shortDesc: Increases friendly Pokémon's Attack and Special Defense to 1.5× during strong sunlight.
flowergift.desc: Friendly Pokémon have 1.5× their Attack and Special Defense during strong sunlight if any friendly Pokémon has this ability. Unlike []{ability:forecast}, []{ability:multitype}, and []{ability:zen-mode}, this ability is not tied to its Pokémon's form change; []{pokemon:cherrim} will switch between its forms even if it loses this ability. As such, this ability also works if obtained by a Pokémon other than Cherrim.

flowerveil.name: Flowerveil
flowerveil.shortDesc: Protects friendly []{type:grass} Pokémon from having their stats lowered by other Pokémon.
flowerveil.desc: Protects friendly []{type:grass} Pokémon from having their stats lowered by other Pokémon.

fluffy.name: Fluffy
fluffy.shortDesc: Damage from contact moves is halved. Damage from Fire moves is doubled.
fluffy.desc: Damage from contact moves is halved. Damage from Fire moves is doubled.

forecast.name: Forecast
forecast.shortDesc: Changes []{pokemon:castform}'s type and form to match the weather.
forecast.desc: During rain, strong sunlight, or hail, this Pokémon's type changes to []{type:water}, []{type:fire}, or []{type:ice}, respectively, and its form changes to match. This ability has no effect for any Pokémon other than []{pokemon:castform}. If the weather ends or becomes anything that does not trigger this ability, or a Pokémon with []{ability:air-lock} or []{ability:cloud-nine} enters battle, this Pokémon's type and form revert to their default. If this ability is lost or disabled, this Pokémon cannot change its current type and form until it regains its ability.

forewarn.name: Forewarn
forewarn.shortDesc: Reveals the opponents' strongest move upon entering battle.
forewarn.desc: When this Pokémon enters battle, it reveals the move with the highest base power known by any opposing Pokémon to all participating trainers. In the event of a tie, one is chosen at random. Moves without a listed base power are assigned one as follows: Power | Moves ----: | ----- 160 | One-hit KO moves: []{move:fissure}, []{move:guillotine}, []{move:horn-drill}, and []{move:sheer-cold} 120 | Counter moves: []{move:counter}, []{move:metal-burst}, and []{move:mirror-coat} 80 | Variable power or set damage: []{move:crush-grip}, []{move:dragon-rage}, []{move:electro-ball}, []{move:endeavor}, []{move:final-gambit}, []{move:flail}, []{move:frustration}, []{move:grass-knot}, []{move:gyro-ball}, []{move:heat-crash}, []{move:heavy-slam}, []{move:hidden-power}, []{move:low-kick}, []{move:natural-gift}, []{move:night-shade}, []{move:psywave}, []{move:return}, []{move:reversal}, []{move:seismic-toss}, []{move:sonic-boom}, []{move:trump-card}, and []{move:wring-out} 0 | Any such move not listed

friendguard.name: Friendguard
friendguard.shortDesc: Decreases all direct damage taken by friendly Pokémon to 0.75×.
friendguard.desc: All friendly Pokémon take 0.75× as much direct damage from moves while this Pokémon is in battle. This effect stacks if multiple allied Pokémon have it.

frisk.name: Frisk
frisk.shortDesc: Reveals an opponent's held item upon entering battle.
frisk.desc: When this Pokémon enters battle, it reveals an opposing Pokémon's held item to all participating trainers. In a double battle, if one opponent has an item, this Pokémon will Frisk that Pokémon; if both have an item, it will Frisk one at random.

fullmetalbody.name: Fullmetalbody
fullmetalbody.shortDesc: Other Pokémon cannot lower this Pokémon's stats.
fullmetalbody.desc: This Pokémon's stats cannot be lowered by other Pokémon's moves or abilities. This effect only applies to normal stat modifications and not more exotic effects such as []{move:topsy-turvy} or []{move:power-swap}. This Ability is not bypassed by []{ability:mold-breaker}, []{ability:teravolt}, or []{ability:turboblaze}.

galewings.name: Galewings
galewings.shortDesc: Raises []{type:flying} moves' priority by one stage.
galewings.desc: At full HP, Flying-type moves have +1 priority.

galvanize.name: Galvanize
galvanize.shortDesc: This Pokémon's Normal moves are Electric and have their power increased to 1.2×.
galvanize.desc: When this Pokémon uses a Normal moves, that move is Electric its power is 1.2×.

gluttony.name: Gluttony
gluttony.shortDesc: Makes the Pokémon eat any held Berry triggered by low HP below 1/2 its max HP.
gluttony.desc: This Pokémon eats any held Berry triggered by low HP when it falls below 50% of its HP, regardless of the Berry's usual threshold.

goodasgold.name: Goodasgold
goodasgold.shortDesc: Prevents opposing Pokémon from using status moves on the Pokémon.
goodasgold.desc: Prevents opposing Pokémon from using status moves on the Pokémon.

gooey.name: Gooey
gooey.shortDesc: Lowers attacking Pokémon's Speed by one stage on contact.
gooey.desc: Lowers attacking Pokémon's Speed by one stage on contact.

gorillatactics.name: Gorillatactics
gorillatactics.shortDesc: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat but only allows the use of the first selected move.
gorillatactics.desc: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat but only allows the use of the first selected move.

grasspelt.name: Grasspelt
grasspelt.shortDesc: Boosts Defense while []{move:grassy-terrain} is in effect.

grassysurge.name: Grassysurge
grassysurge.shortDesc: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Grassy Terrain.
grassysurge.desc: On switch-in, the terrain becomes Grassy Terrain for 5 turns.

grimneigh.name: Grimneigh
grimneigh.shortDesc: Boosts Special Attack after knocking out a Pokémon.
grimneigh.desc: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a terrifying neigh, which boosts its Sp. Atk stat.

guarddog.name: Guarddog
guarddog.shortDesc: Prevents being forced out, and its Attack is boosted if intimidated.
guarddog.desc: Prevents being forced out, and its Attack is boosted if intimidated.

gulpmissile.name: Gulpmissile
gulpmissile.shortDesc: If a Cramorant with Gulp Missile uses Surf or Dive, it catches prey and changes its form depending on its remaining HP.
gulpmissile.desc: When the Pokémon uses Surf or Dive, it will come back with prey. When it takes damage, it will spit out the prey to attack.

guts.name: Guts
guts.shortDesc: Increases Attack to 1.5× with a major status ailment.
guts.desc: Attack is 1.5x when Pokemon has a major status condition.

hadronengine.name: Hadronengine
hadronengine.shortDesc: Creates Electric Terrain on entry and boosts Sp. Atk while the terrain is active.
hadronengine.desc: Creates Electric Terrain on entry and boosts Sp. Atk while the terrain is active.

harvest.name: Harvest
harvest.shortDesc: Has a 50% chance of restoring a used Berry after each turn if the Pokémon has held no items in the meantime.
harvest.desc: After each turn, if the last item this Pokémon consumed was a Berry and it is not currently holding an item, it has a 50% chance of regaining that Berry, or a 100% chance during strong sunlight.

healer.name: Healer
healer.shortDesc: Has a 30% chance of curing each adjacent ally of any major status ailment after each turn.
healer.desc: Friendly Pokémon next to this Pokémon in double and triple battles each have a 30% chance of being cured of any major status ailment after each turn.

heatproof.name: Heatproof
heatproof.shortDesc: Halves damage from []{type:fire} moves and burns.
heatproof.desc: This Pokémon takes half as much damage from []{type:fire}-type moves and burns.

heavymetal.name: Heavymetal
heavymetal.desc: This Pokémon has double the usual weight for its species.

honeygather.name: Honeygather
honeygather.shortDesc: The Pokémon may pick up []{item:honey} after battle.
honeygather.desc: This Pokémon has a chance of picking up []{item:honey} after each battle. This chance starts at 5% and rises another 5% after every tenth level: 5% from level 1–10, 10% from 11–20, and so on, up to 50% from 91–100. This ability is checked after the battle ends, at which point any temporary ability changes have worn off.

hospitality.name: Hospitality
hospitality.shortDesc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally's HP.
hospitality.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally's HP.

hugepower.name: Hugepower
hugepower.desc: This Pokémon's Attack is doubled while in battle. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. This ability functions identically to []{ability:pure-power}.

hungerswitch.name: Hungerswitch
hungerswitch.shortDesc: Causes Morpeko to change its form each turn, alternating between Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode
hungerswitch.desc: The Pokémon changes its form, alternating between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode after the end of every turn.

hustle.name: Hustle
hustle.shortDesc: Strengthens physical moves to inflict 1.5× damage, but decreases their accuracy to 0.8×.
hustle.desc: Increases Attack by 50% but lowers accuracy of physical moves to 80%.

hydration.name: Hydration
hydration.shortDesc: Cures any major status ailment after each turn during rain.
hydration.desc: This Pokémon is cured of any major status ailment after each turn during rain.

hypercutter.name: Hypercutter
hypercutter.shortDesc: Prevents Attack from being lowered by other Pokémon.
hypercutter.desc: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's Attack stat.

icebody.name: Icebody
icebody.shortDesc: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during hail. Protects against hail damage.
icebody.desc: Heals 1/16 HP each turn in snow.

iceface.name: Iceface
iceface.shortDesc: The Pokémon’s ice head can take a physical attack as a substitute, but the attack also changes the Pokémon’s appearance. The ice will be restored when it snows.
iceface.desc: When an Eiscue that's in its Ice Face form is hit by a physical move, it takes no damage and changes into its Noice Face form. If a hailstorm or snowstorm begins while Eiscue is in its Noice Face form, or if it is sent out in its Noice Face form during hail, it will immediately revert to its Ice Face form.

icescales.name: Icescales
icescales.desc: The Pokémon is protected by ice scales, which halve the damage taken from special moves.

illuminate.name: Illuminate
illuminate.desc: Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is doubled. This ability has no effect in battle.

illusion.name: Illusion
illusion.shortDesc: Takes the appearance of the last conscious party Pokémon upon being sent out until hit by a damaging move.
illusion.desc: This Pokémon, upon being sent out, appears to have the species, nickname, and Poké Ball of the last Pokémon in the party that is able to battle. This illusion breaks upon being hit by a damaging move. Other damage, e.g. from weather or []{move:spikes}, does not break the illusion, nor does damage done to a []{move:substitute}. If the party order becomes temporarily shuffled around as Pokémon are switched out in battle, this ability chooses the last Pokémon according to that shuffled order.

imposter.name: Imposter
imposter.desc: Transforms into the opponent Pokemon on switch-in.

innardsout.name: Innardsout
innardsout.shortDesc: When this Pokémon faints from an opponent's move, that opponent takes damage equal to the HP this Pokémon had remaining.
innardsout.desc: When this Pokémon faints from an opponent's move, that opponent takes damage equal to the HP this Pokémon had remaining.

intimidate.name: Intimidate
intimidate.shortDesc: Lowers opponents' Attack one stage upon entering battle.
intimidate.desc: On switch-in, lowers the opponent's Attack by 1 stage.

intrepidsword.name: Intrepidsword
intrepidsword.desc: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat the first time the Pokémon enters a battle.

ironbarbs.name: Ironbarbs
ironbarbs.shortDesc: Damages attacking Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP on contact.
ironbarbs.desc: Attackers that make contact lose 1/8 of their max HP.

ironfist.name: Ironfist
ironfist.shortDesc: Strengthens punch-based moves to 1.2× their power.
ironfist.desc: Moves flagged as being punch-based have 1.2× their base power for this Pokémon. []{move:sucker-punch} is not flagged as punch-based; its original, Japanese name only means "surprise attack".

justified.name: Justified
justified.shortDesc: Raises Attack one stage upon taking damage from a []{type:dark} move.
justified.desc: Whenever a []{type:dark}-type move hits this Pokémon, its Attack rises one stage. The move is not negated in any way.

keeneye.name: Keeneye
keeneye.desc: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's accuracy.

klutz.name: Klutz
klutz.shortDesc: Prevents the Pokémon from using its held item in battle.
klutz.desc: In battle, this Pokémon cannot use its held item, nor will the item have any passive effect on the battle, positive or negative. This Pokémon also cannot use []{move:fling}. The Speed cut from the []{item:iron-ball} and the effort items (the []{item:macho-brace}, []{item:power-weight}, []{item:power-bracer}, []{item:power-belt}, []{item:power-lens}, []{item:power-band}, and []{item:power-anklet}) is unaffected. Items that do not directly affect the battle, such as the []{item:exp-share}, the []{item:amulet-coin}, or the []{item:soothe-bell}, work as usual. All held items work as usual out of battle. Other moves that use the held item, such as []{move:natural-gift} and []{move:switcheroo}, work as usual.

leafguard.name: Leafguard
leafguard.shortDesc: Protects against major status ailments during strong sunlight.
leafguard.desc: This Pokémon cannot be given a major status ailment during strong sunlight. This ability does not heal prior status ailments. []{move:rest} will fail altogether with this ability in effect. []{move:yawn} will immediately fail if used on this Pokémon during strong sunlight, and an already-used Yawn will fail if the weather turns to strong sunlight in the meantime.

libero.name: Libero
libero.shortDesc: Libero changes the Pokémon's type to that of its previously used attack.
libero.desc: Changes the Pokémon’s type to the type of the move it’s about to use. This works only once each time the Pokémon enters battle.

lightmetal.name: Lightmetal
lightmetal.desc: This Pokémon has half the usual weight for its species.

lightningrod.name: Lightningrod
lightningrod.shortDesc: Redirects single-target []{type:electric} moves to this Pokémon where possible. Absorbs Electric moves, raising Special Attack one stage.
lightningrod.desc: Draws Electric-type moves to this Pokemon and grants immunity. Raises Sp. Attack by 1 stage when hit.

lingeringaroma.name: Lingeringaroma
lingeringaroma.shortDesc: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker's Ability to Lingering Aroma.
lingeringaroma.desc: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker's Ability to Lingering Aroma.

liquidooze.name: Liquidooze
liquidooze.shortDesc: Damages opponents using leeching moves for as much as they would heal.
liquidooze.desc: Whenever a Pokémon would heal after hitting this Pokémon with a leeching move like []{move:absorb}, it instead loses as many HP as it would usually gain. []{move:dream-eater} is unaffected.

liquidvoice.name: Liquidvoice
liquidvoice.desc: When this Pokémon uses a move that is sound-based, that move's type is Water.

longreach.name: Longreach
longreach.shortDesc: This Pokémon's moves do not make contact.
longreach.desc: A move used by this Pokémon will not make contact.

magicbounce.name: Magicbounce
magicbounce.shortDesc: Reflects most non-damaging moves back at their user.
magicbounce.desc: Reflects status moves and entry hazards back at the user.

magicguard.name: Magicguard
magicguard.shortDesc: Protects against damage not directly caused by a move.
magicguard.desc: This Pokémon is immune to damage not directly caused by a move. For example, this Pokémon takes no damage from from weather, recoil, status ailments, or []{move:spikes}, but it still suffers from the Attack cut when burned, and a []{item:life-orb} will still power up this Pokémon's moves without damaging it. Anything that directly depends on such damage will also not happen; for example, []{move:leech-seed} will neither hurt this Pokémon nor heal the opponent, and Pokémon with a []{item:jaboca-berry} or []{item:rowap-berry} will not consume the berry when hit by this Pokémon. The following are unaffected: []{move:struggle}, []{move:pain-split} (whether used by or against this Pokémon), []{move:belly-drum}, []{move:substitute}, []{move:curse}, moves that knock the user out, and damage from confusion. This Pokémon will neither lose nor regain HP if it drains HP from a Pokémon with []{ability:liquid-ooze}. If this Pokémon is badly poisoned, the poison counter is still increased each turn; if the Pokémon loses this ability, it will begin taking as much damage as it would be if it had been taking increasing damage each turn.

magician.name: Magician
magician.shortDesc: Steals the target's held item when the bearer uses a damaging move.
magician.desc: Steals the target's held item when hitting with an attack.

magnetpull.name: Magnetpull
magnetpull.shortDesc: Prevents []{type:steel} opponents from fleeing or switching out.
magnetpull.desc: While this Pokémon is in battle, opposing []{type:steel}-type Pokémon cannot flee or switch out. Pokémon with []{ability:run-away} can still flee. Pokémon can still switch out with the use of a move or item. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, Steel-type Pokémon have a higher encounter rate.

marvelscale.name: Marvelscale
marvelscale.shortDesc: Increases Defense to 1.5× with a major status ailment.
marvelscale.desc: Defense is 1.5x when Pokemon has a major status condition.

megalauncher.name: Megalauncher
megalauncher.shortDesc: Strengthens aura and pulse moves to 1.5× their power.
megalauncher.desc: Strengthens aura and pulse moves to 1.5× their power.

merciless.name: Merciless
merciless.shortDesc: This Pokémon's moves critical hit against poisoned targets.
merciless.desc: This Pokémon's moves critical hit against poisoned targets.

mimicry.name: Mimicry
mimicry.shortDesc: Changes type depending on the terrain.
mimicry.desc: Changes the Pokémon’s type depending on the terrain.

mindseye.name: Mindseye
mindseye.shortDesc: Accuracy cannot be lowered, the Pokémon ignores target evasiveness, and its Normal- and Fighting-type moves hit Ghosts.
mindseye.desc: Accuracy cannot be lowered, the Pokémon ignores target evasiveness, and its Normal- and Fighting-type moves hit Ghosts.

minus.name: Minus
minus.shortDesc: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× when a friendly Pokémon has []{ability:plus} or []{ability:minus}.
minus.desc: This Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack if any friendly Pokémon has []{ability:plus} or []{ability:minus}. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. If either ability is disabled by []{move:gastro-acid}, both lose their effect.

mirrorarmor.name: Mirrorarmor
mirrorarmor.desc: Bounces back only the stat-lowering effects that the Pokémon receives.

mistysurge.name: Mistysurge
mistysurge.shortDesc: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Misty Terrain.
mistysurge.desc: On switch-in, the terrain becomes Misty Terrain for 5 turns.

moldbreaker.name: Moldbreaker
moldbreaker.shortDesc: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent a move.
moldbreaker.desc: This Pokémon's moves completely ignore abilities that could hinder or prevent their effect on the target. For example, this Pokémon's moves ignore abilities that would fully negate them, such as []{ability:water-absorb}; abilities that would prevent any of their effects, such as []{ability:clear-body}, []{ability:shell-armor}, or []{ability:sticky-hold}; and abilities that grant any general protective benefit, such as []{ability:simple}, []{ability:snow-cloak}, or []{ability:thick-fat}. If an ability could either hinder or help this Pokémon's moves, e.g. []{ability:dry-skin} or []{ability:unaware}, the ability is ignored either way. Abilities that do not fit this description, even if they could hinder moves in some other way, are not affected. For example, []{ability:cursed-body} only affects potential future uses of the move, while []{ability:liquid-ooze} and []{ability:shadow-tag} can only hinder a move's effect on the user. This ablity cannot ignore type or form changes granted by abilities, for example []{ability:color-change} or []{ability:forecast}; nor effects that were caused by abilities but are no longer tied to an ability, such as the rain from []{ability:drizzle}. This ability cannot ignore []{ability:multitype} at all. An ability ignored by this ability is only nullified while the move is being used. For example, this Pokémon's moves can paralyze a Pokémon with []{ability:limber}, but Limber will activate and heal the paralysis immediately thereafter, and this Pokémon's []{move:spikes} are not affected by this ability after they have been placed. When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability. This ability functions identically to []{ability:teravolt} and []{ability:turboblaze}.

moody.name: Moody
moody.shortDesc: Raises a random stat two stages and lowers another one stage after each turn.
moody.desc: After each turn, one of this Pokémon's stats at random rises two stages, and another falls one stage. If a stat is already at 6 or -6 stages, it will not be chosen to be increased or decreased, respectively.

motordrive.name: Motordrive
motordrive.shortDesc: Absorbs []{type:electric} moves, raising Speed one stage.
motordrive.desc: Grants immunity to Electric-type moves. When hit by Electric moves, raises Speed by 1 stage.

moxie.name: Moxie
moxie.shortDesc: Raises Attack one stage upon KOing a Pokémon.
moxie.desc: This Pokémon's Attack rises one stage upon knocking out another Pokémon, even a friendly Pokémon. This ability does not take effect when the Pokémon indirectly causes another Pokémon to faint, e.g. through poison or []{move:spikes}. If this Pokémon knocks out a Pokémon with []{ability:mummy}, the former's ability will change without taking effect.

multiscale.name: Multiscale
multiscale.shortDesc: Halves damage taken from full HP.
multiscale.desc: Reduces damage by 50% when at full HP.

multitype.name: Multitype
multitype.shortDesc: Changes []{pokemon:arceus}'s type and form to match its held Plate.
multitype.desc: If this Pokémon is holding an elemental Plate, its type and form change to match the Plate. This Pokémon's held item, whether or not it is a Plate, cannot be taken by []{move:covet} or []{move:thief}, nor removed by []{move:knock-off}, nor traded by []{move:switcheroo} or []{move:trick}. Covet, Thief, and Knock Off still inflict damage against this Pokémon. Unlike with []{ability:sticky-hold}, this Pokémon cannot use []{move:fling}, Switcheroo, or Trick to lose its item itself, nor gain an item through Switcheroo or Trick if it does not have one. This ability has no effect for any Pokémon other than []{pokemon:arceus}. This ability cannot be traded with []{move:skill-swap}, nor copied with []{move:role-play} or []{ability:trace}, nor disabled with []{move:gastro-acid}, nor changed with []{move:worry-seed}. This Pokémon cannot use Skill Swap or Role Play to lose its ability itself. []{ability:mold-breaker} cannot ignore this ability. If a Pokémon Transforms into an Arceus with this ability, it will Transform into Arceus's default, []{type:normal}-type form. If the Transforming Pokémon is holding a Plate, this ability will then activate and change the Pokémon into the corresponding form.

mummy.name: Mummy
mummy.shortDesc: Changes attacking Pokémon's abilities to Mummy on contact.
mummy.desc: Whenever a contact move hits this Pokémon, the attacking Pokémon's ability changes to Mummy. []{ability:multitype} is unaffected. If a Pokémon with []{ability:moxie} knocks this Pokémon out, the former's ability will change without taking effect.

myceliummight.name: Myceliummight
myceliummight.shortDesc: Status moves go last but ignore the target's Ability.
myceliummight.desc: Status moves go last but ignore the target's Ability.

naturalcure.name: Naturalcure
naturalcure.shortDesc: Cures any major status ailment upon switching out.
naturalcure.desc: This Pokémon is cured of any major status ailment when it is switched out for another Pokémon. If this ability is acquired during battle, the Pokémon is cured upon leaving battle before losing the temporary ability.

neutralizinggas.name: Neutralizinggas
neutralizinggas.shortDesc: Neutralizes abilities of all Pokémon in battle.
neutralizinggas.desc: While the Pokémon is in the battle, the effects of all other Pokémon’s Abilities will be nullified or will not be triggered.

noguard.name: Noguard
noguard.shortDesc: Ensures all moves used by and against the Pokémon hit.
noguard.desc: All moves used by or against this Pokemon always hit.

normalize.name: Normalize
normalize.shortDesc: Makes the Pokémon's moves all act []{type:normal}-type.
normalize.desc: This Pokémon's moves all act as if they were []{type:normal}-type. Moves that inflict typeless damage do so as usual. Moves of variable type, such as []{move:hidden-power}, are affected. They otherwise work as usual, however; []{move:weather-ball}, for example, is always forced to be Normal, but it still has doubled power and looks different during weather. As []{move:thunder-wave} is prevented by immunities, unlike most non-damaging moves, it does not affect []{type:ghost}-type Pokémon under the effect of this ability.

opportunist.name: Opportunist
opportunist.shortDesc: When an opposing Pokémon's stat is raised, the Pokémon copies the stat increase.
opportunist.desc: When an opposing Pokémon's stat is raised, the Pokémon copies the stat increase.

orichalcumpulse.name: Orichalcumpulse
orichalcumpulse.shortDesc: Summons harsh sunlight on entry and boosts the Pokémon's Attack in sunlight.
orichalcumpulse.desc: Summons harsh sunlight on entry and boosts the Pokémon's Attack in sunlight.

overcoat.name: Overcoat
overcoat.desc: This Pokémon does not take damage from weather.

overgrow.name: Overgrow
overgrow.shortDesc: Strengthens []{type:grass} moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
overgrow.desc: When HP is below 1/3, Grass-type moves have 1.5x power.

parentalbond.name: Parentalbond
parentalbond.shortDesc: Lets the bearer hit twice with damaging moves. The second hit has half power.
parentalbond.desc: Lets the bearer hit twice with damaging moves. The second hit has half power.

pastelveil.name: Pastelveil
pastelveil.shortDesc: Prevents the Pokémon and its allies from being poisoned.
pastelveil.desc: Prevents the Pokémon and its teammates from being poisoned. It also cures teammates of poisoning when it enters the battlefield.

perishbody.name: Perishbody
perishbody.shortDesc: When hit by a move that makes direct contact, the Pokémon and the attacker will faint after three turns unless they switch out of battle.
perishbody.desc: When the Pokémon with Perish Body is hit with a contact move, both the attacker and the Pokémon with Perish Body will faint in three turns.

pickpocket.name: Pickpocket
pickpocket.shortDesc: Steals attacking Pokémon's held items on contact.
pickpocket.desc: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, if it does not have a held item, it steals the attacker's held item. This Pokémon cannot steal upon being knocked out. It can steal if the attacker has a []{move:substitute}, but cannot steal when its own Substitute is hit. If a move hits multiple times, only the last hit triggers this ability. If this Pokémon is wild, it cannot steal from a trained Pokémon.

pickup.name: Pickup
pickup.shortDesc: Picks up other Pokémon's used and Flung held items. May also pick up an item after battle.
pickup.desc: At the end of each turn, if another Pokémon consumed or Flung a held item that turn, this Pokémon picks up the item if it is not already holding one. After each battle, this Pokémon has a 10% chance of picking up an item if it is not already holding one. The []{item:air-balloon} and []{item:eject-button} cannot be picked up. The items that may be found vary by game, and, since Pokémon Emerald, by the Pokémon's level. This ability is checked after the battle ends, at which point any temporary ability changes have worn off.

pixilate.name: Pixilate
pixilate.shortDesc: Turns the bearer's []{type:normal} moves into []{type:fairy} moves and strengthens them to 1.3× their power.
pixilate.desc: Turns the bearer's []{type:normal}-type moves into []{type:fairy} moves. Moves changed by this ability have 1.3× their power.

plus.name: Plus
plus.shortDesc: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× when a friendly Pokémon has []{ability:plus} or []{ability:minus}.
plus.desc: This Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack if any friendly Pokémon has []{ability:plus} or []{ability:minus}. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. If either ability is disabled by []{move:gastro-acid}, both lose their effect.

poisonheal.name: Poisonheal
poisonheal.shortDesc: Heals for 1/8 max HP after each turn when poisoned in place of damage.
poisonheal.desc: If this Pokémon is poisoned, it will heal for 1/8 of its maximum HP after each turn rather than taking damage. This includes bad poison.

poisonpoint.name: Poisonpoint
poisonpoint.shortDesc: Has a 30% chance of poisoning attacking Pokémon on contact.
poisonpoint.desc: 30% chance to poison attackers that make contact.

poisonpuppeteer.name: Poisonpuppeteer
poisonpuppeteer.shortDesc: Pokémon poisoned by the Pokémon's status moves will also become confused.
poisonpuppeteer.desc: Pokémon poisoned by the Pokémon's status moves will also become confused.

poisontouch.name: Poisontouch
poisontouch.shortDesc: Has a 30% chance of poisoning target Pokémon upon contact.
poisontouch.desc: This Pokémon's contact moves have a 30% chance of poisoning the target with each hit. This counts as an extra effect for the purposes of []{ability:shield-dust}. This ability takes effect before []{ability:mummy}.

powerconstruct.name: Powerconstruct
powerconstruct.shortDesc: Transforms 10% or 50% Zygarde into Complete Forme when its HP is below 50%.
powerconstruct.desc: Transforms 10% or 50% Zygarde into Complete Forme when its HP is below 50%. This ability cannot be copied or replaced. This ability only takes effect for Zygarde.

powerofalchemy.name: Powerofalchemy
powerofalchemy.shortDesc: When an ally faints, this Pokémon gains its Ability.
powerofalchemy.desc: When an ally faints, this Pokémon gains its Ability.

powerspot.name: Powerspot
powerspot.shortDesc: Just being next to the Pokémon powers up moves.
powerspot.desc: "The power of moves used by the allies of the Pokémon with Power Spot is increased by 30%."

prankster.name: Prankster
prankster.shortDesc: Raises non-damaging moves' priority by one stage.

pressure.name: Pressure
pressure.shortDesc: Increases the PP cost of moves targetting the Pokémon by one.
pressure.desc: Moves targetting this Pokémon use one extra PP. This ability stacks if multiple targets have it. This ability still affects moves that fail or miss. This ability does not affect ally moves that target either the entire field or just its side, nor this Pokémon's self-targetted moves; it does, however, affect single-targetted ally moves aimed at this Pokémon, ally moves that target all other Pokémon, and opponents' moves that target the entire field. If this ability raises a move's PP cost above its remaining PP, it will use all remaining PP. When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, higher-levelled Pokémon have their encounter rate increased.

primordialsea.name: Primordialsea
primordialsea.shortDesc: Creates heavy rain, which has all the properties of Rain Dance, cannot be replaced, and causes damaging Fire moves to fail.
primordialsea.desc: When this Pokémon enters battle or gains this ability, the weather becomes heavy rain. Heavy rain has all the properties of []{move:rain-dance} and also causes damaging Fire moves to fail. Heavy rain ends when this Pokémon leaves battle or loses this ability, or when this ability is nullified. The weather cannot otherwise be changed except by the effects of []{ability:delta-stream} and []{ability:desolate-land}. []{ability:air-lock} and []{ability:cloud-nine} will prevent the effects of heavy rain, including allowing Fire moves to work, but will not allow the weather to be changed.

prismarmor.name: Prismarmor
prismarmor.desc: Super-effective damage this Pokémon takes is reduced to 0.75×. This Ability is not bypassed by []{ability:mold-breaker}, []{ability:teravolt}, or []{ability:turboblaze}.

propellertail.name: Propellertail
propellertail.shortDesc: Ignores moves and abilities that draw in moves.
propellertail.desc: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon’s Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

protean.name: Protean
protean.shortDesc: Changes the bearer's type to match each move it uses.
protean.desc: Changes the bearer's type to match each move it uses. The type change takes place just before the move is used.

protosynthesis.name: Protosynthesis
protosynthesis.shortDesc: In harsh sunlight or with Booster Energy, the Pokémon's highest stat is boosted.
protosynthesis.desc: In harsh sunlight or with Booster Energy, the Pokémon's highest stat is boosted.

psychicsurge.name: Psychicsurge
psychicsurge.shortDesc: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Psychic Terrain.
psychicsurge.desc: On switch-in, the terrain becomes Psychic Terrain for 5 turns.

punkrock.name: Punkrock
punkrock.shortDesc: Boosts sound-based moves and halves damage from the same moves.
punkrock.desc: Boosts the power of sound-based moves. The Pokémon also takes half the damage from these kinds of moves.

purepower.name: Purepower
purepower.desc: This Pokémon's Attack is doubled in battle. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. This ability functions identically to []{ability:huge-power}.

purifyingsalt.name: Purifyingsalt
purifyingsalt.shortDesc: Halves damage from Ghost-type moves and protects the Pokémon from status conditions.
purifyingsalt.desc: Halves damage from Ghost-type moves and protects the Pokémon from status conditions.

quarkdrive.name: Quarkdrive
quarkdrive.shortDesc: In Electric Terrain or with Booster Energy, the Pokémon's highest stat is boosted.
quarkdrive.desc: In Electric Terrain or with Booster Energy, the Pokémon's highest stat is boosted.

queenlymajesty.name: Queenlymajesty
queenlymajesty.shortDesc: Opposing Pokémon cannot use priority attacks.
queenlymajesty.desc: When an opposing Pokémon attempts to use a move that targets this Pokémon or an ally, and that move has priority, it will fail.

quickdraw.name: Quickdraw
quickdraw.shortDesc: Enables the Pokémon to move first occasionally.
quickdraw.desc: If a Pokémon with this Ability selects a damaging move, it has a 30% chance of going first in its priority bracket.

quickfeet.name: Quickfeet
quickfeet.shortDesc: Increases Speed to 1.5× with a major status ailment.
quickfeet.desc: Whenever this Pokémon has a major status ailment, it has 1.5× its Speed. This Pokémon is not affected by the usual Speed cut from paralysis. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved.

raindish.name: Raindish
raindish.shortDesc: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during rain.
raindish.desc: Heals 1/16 HP each turn in rain.

rattled.name: Rattled
rattled.shortDesc: Raises Speed one stage upon being hit by a []{type:dark}, []{type:ghost}, or []{type:bug} move.
rattled.desc: This Pokémon's Speed rises one stage with each hit from a damaging []{type:dark}-, []{type:ghost}-, or []{type:bug}-type move.

receiver.name: Receiver
receiver.shortDesc: When an ally faints, this Pokémon gains its Ability.
receiver.desc: When an ally faints, this Pokémon gains its Ability.

reckless.name: Reckless
reckless.shortDesc: Strengthens recoil moves to 1.2× their power.
reckless.desc: This Pokémon's recoil moves and crash moves have 1.2× their base power. []{move:struggle} is unaffected. The "crash moves" are the moves that damage the user upon missing: []{move:jump-kick} and []{move:high-jump-kick}.

refrigerate.name: Refrigerate
refrigerate.shortDesc: Turns the bearer's []{type:normal} moves into []{type:ice} moves and strengthens them to 1.3× their power.
refrigerate.desc: Turns the bearer's []{type:normal}-type moves into []{type:ice}-type moves. Moves changed by this ability have 1.3× their power.

regenerator.name: Regenerator
regenerator.shortDesc: Heals for 1/3 max HP upon switching out.

ripen.name: Ripen
ripen.desc: Ripens Berries and doubles their effect.

rivalry.name: Rivalry
rivalry.shortDesc: Increases damage inflicted to 1.25× against Pokémon of the same gender, but decreases damage to 0.75× against the opposite gender.
rivalry.desc: This Pokémon inflicts 1.25× as much regular damage against Pokémon of the same gender and 0.75× as much regular damage against Pokémon of the opposite gender. If either Pokémon is genderless, damage is unaffected.

rkssystem.name: Rkssystem
rkssystem.shortDesc: Changes this Pokémon's type to match its held Memory.
rkssystem.desc: Changes this Pokémon's type to match its held Memory. This ability cannot be copied, replaced, or nullified. This ability only takes effect for Silvally.

rockhead.name: Rockhead
rockhead.desc: This Pokémon does not receive recoil damage from its recoil moves. []{move:struggle}'s recoil is unaffected. This ability does not prevent crash damage from missing with []{move:jump-kick} or []{move:high-jump-kick}.

roughskin.name: Roughskin
roughskin.shortDesc: Damages attacking Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP on contact.
roughskin.desc: Attackers that make contact lose 1/8 of their max HP.

runaway.name: Runaway
runaway.shortDesc: Ensures success fleeing from wild battles.
runaway.desc: This Pokémon is always successful fleeing from wild battles, even if trapped by a move or ability.

sandforce.name: Sandforce
sandforce.shortDesc: Strengthens []{type:rock}, []{type:ground}, and []{type:steel} moves to 1.3× their power during a sandstorm. Protects against sandstorm damage.
sandforce.desc: In sandstorm, Rock/Ground/Steel moves have 1.3x power and immune to sandstorm damage.

sandrush.name: Sandrush
sandrush.shortDesc: Doubles Speed during a sandstorm. Protects against sandstorm damage.

sandspit.name: Sandspit
sandspit.shortDesc: Creates a sandstorm when hit by an attack.
sandspit.desc: The Pokémon creates a sandstorm when it’s hit by an attack.

sandstream.name: Sandstream
sandstream.shortDesc: Summons a sandstorm that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.
sandstream.desc: On switch-in, the weather becomes sandstorm for 5 turns.

sandveil.name: Sandveil
sandveil.shortDesc: Increases evasion to 1.25× during a sandstorm. Protects against sandstorm damage.
sandveil.desc: During a sandstorm, this Pokémon has 1.25× its evasion, and it does not take sandstorm damage regardless of type. The evasion bonus does not count as a stat modifier. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in a sandstorm.

sapsipper.name: Sapsipper
sapsipper.shortDesc: Absorbs []{type:grass} moves, raising Attack one stage.
sapsipper.desc: Grants immunity to Grass-type moves. When hit by Grass moves, raises Attack by 1 stage.

schooling.name: Schooling
schooling.shortDesc: Wishiwashi (Lv. 20+) is in School Form above 25% HP, Solo otherwise.
schooling.desc: If a Wishiwashi is level 20 or above, it becomes School Form when its HP is at least 25% of its maximum HP and reverts to Solo Form otherwise. The check occurs on switch-in and at the start/end of each turn.

scrappy.name: Scrappy
scrappy.shortDesc: Lets the Pokémon's []{type:normal} and []{type:fighting} moves hit []{type:ghost} Pokémon.
scrappy.desc: This Pokémon ignores []{type:ghost}-type Pokémon's immunity to []{type:normal}- and []{type:fighting}-type moves. Ghost Pokémon's other types affect damage as usual.

screencleaner.name: Screencleaner
screencleaner.shortDesc: Nullifies effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil.
screencleaner.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.

seedsower.name: Seedsower
seedsower.shortDesc: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.
seedsower.desc: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.

serenegrace.name: Serenegrace
serenegrace.shortDesc: Doubles the chance of moves' extra effects occurring.
serenegrace.desc: Doubles the chance of moves' secondary effects occurring.

shadowshield.name: Shadowshield
shadowshield.shortDesc: When this Pokémon has full HP, regular damage from moves is halved.
shadowshield.desc: When this Pokémon has full HP, regular damage (not fixed damage!) from moves is halved. This ability cannot be nullified.

shadowtag.name: Shadowtag
shadowtag.shortDesc: Prevents opponents from fleeing or switching out.
shadowtag.desc: While this Pokémon is in battle, opposing Pokémon cannot flee or switch out. Other Pokémon with this ability are unaffected. Pokémon with []{ability:run-away} can still flee. Pokémon can still switch out with the use of a move or item.

shedskin.name: Shedskin
shedskin.shortDesc: Has a 33% chance of curing any major status ailment after each turn.
shedskin.desc: After each turn, this Pokémon has a 33% of being cured of any major status ailment.

sheerforce.name: Sheerforce
sheerforce.shortDesc: Strengthens moves with extra effects to 1.3× their power, but prevents their extra effects.
sheerforce.desc: Removes secondary effects from moves but increases their power by 30%.

shellarmor.name: Shellarmor
shellarmor.desc: Protects the Pokemon from critical hits.

shielddust.name: Shielddust
shielddust.shortDesc: Protects against incoming moves' extra effects.
shielddust.desc: This Pokémon is immune to the extra effects of moves used against it. An extra effect is a move's chance, listed as an "effect chance", to inflict a status ailment, cause a stat change, or make the target flinch in addition to the move's main effect. For example, []{move:thunder-shock}'s paralysis is an extra effect, but []{move:thunder-wave}'s is not, nor are []{move:knock-off}'s item removal and []{move:air-cutter}'s increased critical hit rate.

shieldsdown.name: Shieldsdown
shieldsdown.shortDesc: Transforms this Minior between Core Form and Meteor Form. Prevents major status ailments and drowsiness while in Meteor Form.
shieldsdown.desc: When this Pokémon enters battle and at the end of each turn, if its HP is 50% or above, it changes into Meteor Form; otherwise, it changes into Core Form. In Meteor Form, it cannot be given a major status ailment (though existing ones are not cured), cannot become drowsy from []{move:yawn}, and cannot use []{move:rest} (which will simply fail). This ability cannot be copied, replaced, or nullified. This ability only takes effect for Minior.

simple.name: Simple
simple.shortDesc: Doubles the Pokémon's stat modifiers. These doubled modifiers are still capped at -6 or 6 stages.
simple.desc: Each stage of this Pokémon's stat modifiers acts as two stages. These doubled stages are still limited to a minimum of -6 and a maximum of 6. This Pokémon can still accumulate less than -3 or more than 3 stages of stat modifiers, even though the extra ones have no effect after doubling.

skilllink.name: Skilllink
skilllink.shortDesc: Extends two-to-five-hit moves and []{move:triple-kick} to their full length every time.
skilllink.desc: Multi-hit moves always hit the maximum number of times.

slowstart.name: Slowstart
slowstart.shortDesc: Halves Attack and Speed for five turns upon entering battle.
slowstart.desc: This Pokémon's Attack and Speed are halved for five turns upon entering battle. This ability also takes effect when acquired during battle. If this Pokémon loses its ability before the five turns are up, its Attack and Speed return to normal; if it then regains this ability without leaving battle, its Attack and Speed are halved again, but the counter keeps counting from where it was.

slushrush.name: Slushrush
slushrush.shortDesc: During Hail, this Pokémon has double Speed.

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.shortDesc: Strengthens critical hits to inflict 3× damage rather than 2×.
sniper.desc: Critical hits deal 2.25x damage instead of 1.5x.

snowcloak.name: Snowcloak
snowcloak.shortDesc: Increases evasion to 1.25× during hail. Protects against hail damage.
snowcloak.desc: During hail, this Pokémon has 1.25× its evasion, and it does not take hail damage regardless of type. The evasion bonus does not count as a stat modifier. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in snow.

snowwarning.name: Snowwarning
snowwarning.shortDesc: Summons hail that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.
snowwarning.desc: On switch-in, the weather becomes snow for 5 turns.

solarpower.name: Solarpower
solarpower.shortDesc: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× but costs 1/8 max HP after each turn during strong sunlight.
solarpower.desc: In harsh sunlight, Sp. Attack is 1.5x but takes 1/8 HP damage per turn.

solidrock.name: Solidrock
solidrock.shortDesc: Decreases damage taken from super-effective moves by 1/4.
solidrock.desc: Reduces damage from super-effective moves by 25%.

soulheart.name: Soulheart
soulheart.shortDesc: This Pokémon's Special Attack rises by one stage every time any Pokémon faints.
soulheart.desc: This Pokémon's Special Attack rises by one stage every time any Pokémon faints.

soundproof.name: Soundproof
soundproof.desc: This Pokémon is immune to moves flagged as being sound-based. []{move:heal-bell} is unaffected. []{move:uproar} still prevents this Pokémon from sleeping. This Pokémon can still receive a Perish Song counter through []{move:baton-pass}, and will retain a Perish Song counter if it acquires this ability after Perish Song is used. []{move:howl}, []{move:roar-of-time}, []{move:sonic-boom}, and []{move:yawn} are not flagged as sound-based.

speedboost.name: Speedboost
speedboost.shortDesc: Raises Speed one stage after each turn.
speedboost.desc: This Pokémon's Speed rises one stage after each turn.

stakeout.name: Stakeout
stakeout.shortDesc: This Pokémon's moves have double power against Pokémon that switched in this turn.
stakeout.desc: This Pokémon's moves have double power against Pokémon that switched in this turn.

stall.name: Stall
stall.shortDesc: Makes the Pokémon move last within its move's priority bracket.
stall.desc: This Pokémon moves last within its priority bracket. Multiple Pokémon with this ability move in order of Speed amongst themselves. The []{item:full-incense} and []{item:lagging-tail} take precedence over this ability; that is, Pokémon with these items move after Pokémon with this ability. Pokémon with both this ability and one of these items are delayed as much as if they had only the item. This ability works as usual during []{move:trick-room}: Pokémon with this ability will move in reverse order of Speed after Pokémon without it.

stalwart.name: Stalwart
stalwart.shortDesc: Ignores moves and abilities that draw in moves.
stalwart.desc: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon’s Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

stamina.name: Stamina
stamina.shortDesc: Raises this Pokémon's Defense by one stage when it takes damage from a move.
stamina.desc: Raises this Pokémon's Defense by one stage when it takes damage from a move.

stancechange.name: Stancechange
stancechange.shortDesc: Changes []{pokemon:aegislash} to Blade Forme before using a damaging move, or Shield Forme before using []{move:kings-shield}.
stancechange.desc: Changes []{pokemon:aegislash} to Blade Forme before using a damaging move, or Shield Forme before using []{move:kings-shield}.

static.name: Static
static.shortDesc: Has a 30% chance of paralyzing attacking Pokémon on contact.
static.desc: 30% chance to paralyze attackers that make contact.

steadfast.name: Steadfast
steadfast.shortDesc: Raises Speed one stage upon flinching.
steadfast.desc: Whenever this Pokémon flinches, its Speed rises one stage.

steamengine.name: Steamengine
steamengine.shortDesc: Boosts the Speed stat drastically when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire- or Water-type move.
steamengine.desc: Raises the user's Speed by three stages when it is hit by a Fire- or Water-type attack. The attack still deals damage.

steelworker.name: Steelworker
steelworker.shortDesc: This Pokémon's Steel moves have 1.5× power.
steelworker.desc: This Pokémon's Steel moves have 1.5× power.

steelyspirit.name: Steelyspirit
steelyspirit.shortDesc: Powers up ally Pokémon's Steel-type moves.
steelyspirit.desc: Powers up the Steel-type moves of the Pokémon and its allies.

stench.name: Stench
stench.shortDesc: Has a 10% chance of making target Pokémon flinch with each hit.
stench.desc: This Pokémon's damaging moves have a 10% chance to make the target flinch with each hit if they do not already cause flinching as a secondary effect. This ability does not stack with a held item. Overworld: The wild encounter rate is halved while this Pokémon is first in the party.

stickyhold.name: Stickyhold
stickyhold.shortDesc: Prevents a held item from being removed by other Pokémon.
stickyhold.desc: Prevents the Pokemon's item from being removed by other Pokemon.

stormdrain.name: Stormdrain
stormdrain.shortDesc: Redirects single-target []{type:water} moves to this Pokémon where possible. Absorbs Water moves, raising Special Attack one stage.
stormdrain.desc: Draws Water-type moves to this Pokemon and grants immunity. Raises Sp. Attack by 1 stage when hit.

strongjaw.name: Strongjaw
strongjaw.shortDesc: Strengthens biting moves to 1.5× their power.
strongjaw.desc: Strengthens biting moves to 1.5× their power.

sturdy.name: Sturdy
sturdy.shortDesc: Prevents being KOed from full HP, leaving 1 HP instead. Protects against the one-hit KO moves regardless of HP.
sturdy.desc: Cannot be KO'd in one hit from full HP. Immune to OHKO moves.

suctioncups.name: Suctioncups
suctioncups.shortDesc: Prevents being forced out of battle by other Pokémon's moves.
suctioncups.desc: This Pokémon cannot be forced out of battle by moves such as []{move:whirlwind}. []{move:dragon-tail} and []{move:circle-throw} still inflict damage against this Pokémon. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the success rate while fishing is increased.

superluck.name: Superluck
superluck.shortDesc: Raises moves' critical hit rates one stage.
superluck.desc: Increases critical hit ratio by 1 stage.

supersweetsyrup.name: Supersweetsyrup
supersweetsyrup.shortDesc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers foes with syrup that lowers their evasiveness.
supersweetsyrup.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers foes with syrup that lowers their evasiveness.

supremeoverlord.name: Supremeoverlord
supremeoverlord.shortDesc: Powers up the Pokémon's moves for each ally that has fainted.
supremeoverlord.desc: Powers up the Pokémon's moves for each ally that has fainted.

surgesurfer.name: Surgesurfer
surgesurfer.shortDesc: Doubles this Pokémon's Speed on Electric Terrain.

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.shortDesc: Strengthens []{type:bug} moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
swarm.desc: When HP is below 1/3, Bug-type moves have 1.5x power.

symbiosis.name: Symbiosis
symbiosis.shortDesc: Passes the bearer's held item to an ally when the ally uses up its item.
symbiosis.desc: Passes the bearer's held item to an ally when the ally uses up its item.

synchronize.name: Synchronize
synchronize.shortDesc: Copies burns, paralysis, and poison received onto the Pokémon that inflicted them.
synchronize.desc: Whenever this Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, the Pokémon who gave this Pokémon that ailment is also given the ailment. This ability passes back bad poison when this Pokémon is badly poisoned. This ability cannot pass on a status ailment that the Pokémon did not directly receive from another Pokémon, such as the poison from []{move:toxic-spikes} or the burn from a []{item:flame-orb}. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, wild Pokémon have a 50% chance of having the lead Pokémon's nature, and a 50% chance of being given a random nature as usual, including the lead Pokémon's nature. This does not work on Pokémon received outside of battle or roaming legendaries.

swordofruin.name: Swordofruin
swordofruin.shortDesc: Lowers the Defense of all opposing Pokémon.
swordofruin.desc: Lowers the Defense of all opposing Pokémon.

tabletsofruin.name: Tabletsofruin
tabletsofruin.shortDesc: Lowers the Attack of all opposing Pokémon.
tabletsofruin.desc: Lowers the Attack of all opposing Pokémon.

tangledfeet.name: Tangledfeet
tangledfeet.desc: When this Pokémon is confused, it has twice its evasion.

tanglinghair.name: Tanglinghair
tanglinghair.shortDesc: When this Pokémon takes regular damage from a contact move, the attacking Pokémon's Speed lowers by one stage.
tanglinghair.desc: When this Pokémon takes regular damage from a contact move, the attacking Pokémon's Speed lowers by one stage.

technician.name: Technician
technician.shortDesc: Strengthens moves of 60 base power or less to 1.5× their power.
technician.desc: Moves with 60 power or less have 1.5x power.

telepathy.name: Telepathy
telepathy.shortDesc: Protects against friendly Pokémon's damaging moves.
telepathy.desc: This Pokémon does not take damage from friendly Pokémon's moves, including single-target moves aimed at it.

teraformzero.name: Teraformzero
teraformzero.shortDesc: As soon as Terapagos assumes its Stellar Form, it will immediately neutralize weather and terrain effects.
teraformzero.desc: When Terapagos changes into its Stellar Form, it uses its hidden powers to eliminate all effects of weather and terrain, reducing them to zero.

terashell.name: Terashell
terashell.shortDesc: All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.
terashell.desc: The Pokémon’s shell contains the powers of each type. All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.

terashift.name: Terashift
terashift.shortDesc: When Terapagos enters the battle, it turns into its Terastal Form until the end of the battle.
terashift.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.

teravolt.name: Teravolt
teravolt.shortDesc: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent moves.
teravolt.desc: This Pokémon's moves completely ignore abilities that could hinder or prevent their effect on the target. For example, this Pokémon's moves ignore abilities that would fully negate them, such as []{ability:water-absorb}; abilities that would prevent any of their effects, such as []{ability:clear-body}, []{ability:shell-armor}, or []{ability:sticky-hold}; and abilities that grant any general protective benefit, such as []{ability:simple}, []{ability:snow-cloak}, or []{ability:thick-fat}. If an ability could either hinder or help this Pokémon's moves, e.g. []{ability:dry-skin} or []{ability:unaware}, the ability is ignored either way. Abilities that do not fit this description, even if they could hinder moves in some other way, are not affected. For example, []{ability:cursed-body} only affects potential future uses of the move, while []{ability:liquid-ooze} and []{ability:shadow-tag} can only hinder a move's effect on the user. This ablity cannot ignore type or form changes granted by abilities, for example []{ability:color-change} or []{ability:forecast}; nor effects that were caused by abilities but are no longer tied to an ability, such as the rain from []{ability:drizzle}. This ability cannot ignore []{ability:multitype} at all. An ability ignored by this ability is only nullified while the move is being used. For example, this Pokémon's moves can paralyze a Pokémon with []{ability:limber}, but Limber will activate and heal the paralysis immediately thereafter, and this Pokémon's []{move:spikes} are not affected by this ability after they have been placed. When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability. This ability functions identically to []{ability:mold-breaker} and []{ability:turboblaze}.

thermalexchange.name: Thermalexchange
thermalexchange.shortDesc: Attack is boosted when hit by a Fire move, and the Pokémon cannot be burned.
thermalexchange.desc: Attack is boosted when hit by a Fire move, and the Pokémon cannot be burned.

thickfat.name: Thickfat
thickfat.desc: Halves damage from Fire and Ice-type moves.

tintedlens.name: Tintedlens
tintedlens.shortDesc: Doubles damage inflicted with not-very-effective moves.
tintedlens.desc: This Pokémon deals twice as much damage with moves that are not very effective against the target.

torrent.name: Torrent
torrent.shortDesc: Strengthens []{type:water} moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
torrent.desc: When HP is below 1/3, Water-type moves have 1.5x power.

toughclaws.name: Toughclaws
toughclaws.shortDesc: Strengthens moves that make contact to 1.33× their power.
toughclaws.desc: Strengthens moves that make contact to 1.33× their power.

toxicboost.name: Toxicboost
toxicboost.desc: This Pokémon has 1.5× its Attack when poisoned.

toxicchain.name: Toxicchain
toxicchain.shortDesc: Damaging moves have a chance to badly poison the target.
toxicchain.desc: Damaging moves have a chance to badly poison the target.

toxicdebris.name: Toxicdebris
toxicdebris.shortDesc: Sets Toxic Spikes on the opposing field when the Pokémon is hit by a physical move.
toxicdebris.desc: Sets Toxic Spikes on the opposing field when the Pokémon is hit by a physical move.

trace.name: Trace
trace.shortDesc: Copies an opponent's ability upon entering battle.
trace.desc: Copies the ability of an opponent.

transistor.name: Transistor
transistor.desc: Increases the power of Electric-type moves used by this Pokémon by 50%.

triage.name: Triage
triage.shortDesc: This Pokémon's healing moves have their priority increased by 3.
triage.desc: This Pokémon's healing moves have their priority increased by 3.

truant.name: Truant
truant.desc: Every second turn on which this Pokémon should attempt to use a move, it will instead do nothing ("loaf around"). Loafing around interrupts moves that take multiple turns the same way paralysis, flinching, etc do. Most such moves, for example []{move:bide} or []{move:rollout}, are simply cut off upon loafing around. Attacks with a recharge turn, such as []{move:hyper-beam}, do not have to recharge; attacks with a preparation turn, such as []{move:fly}, do not end up being used. Moves that are forced over multiple turns and keep going through failure, such as []{move:outrage}, []{move:uproar}, or any move forced by []{move:encore}, keep going as usual. If this Pokémon is confused, its confusion is not checked when loafing around; the Pokémon cannot hurt itself, and its confusion does not end or come closer to ending. If this Pokémon attempts to move but fails, e.g. because of paralysis or []{move:gravity}, it still counts as having moved and will loaf around the next turn. If it does not attempt to move, e.g. because it is asleep or frozen, whatever it would have done will be postponed until its next attempt; that is, it will either loaf around or move as usual, depending on what it last did. This ability cannot be changed with []{move:worry-seed}, but it can be disabled with []{move:gastro-acid}, changed with []{move:role-play}, or traded away with []{move:skill-swap}.

turboblaze.name: Turboblaze
turboblaze.shortDesc: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent moves.
turboblaze.desc: This Pokémon's moves completely ignore abilities that could hinder or prevent their effect on the target.
