For example, this Pokémon's moves ignore abilities that would fully negate them, such as []{ability:water-absorb}; abilities that would prevent any of their effects, such as []{ability:clear-body}, []{ability:shell-armor}, or []{ability:sticky-hold}; and abilities that grant any general protective benefit, such as []{ability:simple}, []{ability:snow-cloak}, or []{ability:thick-fat}. If an ability could either hinder or help this Pokémon's moves, e.g. []{ability:dry-skin} or []{ability:unaware}, the ability is ignored either way. Abilities that do not fit this description, even if they could hinder moves in some other way, are not affected. For example, []{ability:cursed-body} only affects potential future uses of the move, while []{ability:liquid-ooze} and []{ability:shadow-tag} can only hinder a move's effect on the user. This ablity cannot ignore type or form changes granted by abilities, for example []{ability:color-change} or []{ability:forecast}; nor effects that were caused by abilities but are no longer tied to an ability, such as the rain from []{ability:drizzle}. This ability cannot ignore []{ability:multitype} at all. An ability ignored by this ability is only nullified while the move is being used. For example, this Pokémon's moves can paralyze a Pokémon with []{ability:limber}, but Limber will activate and heal the paralysis immediately thereafter, and this Pokémon's []{move:spikes} are not affected by this ability after they have been placed. When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability. This ability functions identically to []{ability:mold-breaker} and []{ability:teravolt}.

unaware.name: Unaware
unaware.shortDesc: Ignores other Pokémon's stat modifiers for damage and accuracy calculation.
unaware.desc: This Pokémon ignores other Pokémon's stat modifiers for the purposes of damage and accuracy calculation. Effectively, this affects modifiers of every stat except Speed. The power of []{move:punishment} and []{move:stored-power} is calculated as usual. When this Pokémon hurts itself in confusion, its stat modifiers affect damage as usual.

unburden.name: Unburden
unburden.shortDesc: Doubles Speed upon using or losing a held item.
unburden.desc: Speed doubles after consuming a held item.

unnerve.name: Unnerve
unnerve.shortDesc: Prevents opposing Pokémon from eating held Berries.
unnerve.desc: Opposing Pokémon cannot eat held Berries while this Pokémon is in battle. Affected Pokémon can still use []{move:bug-bite} or []{move:pluck} to eat a target's Berry.

unseenfist.name: Unseenfist
unseenfist.shortDesc: Contact moves can strike through Protect/Detect.
unseenfist.desc: If the Pokémon uses moves that make direct contact, it can attack the target even if the target protects itself.

vesselofruin.name: Vesselofruin
vesselofruin.shortDesc: Lowers the Sp. Atk of all opposing Pokémon.
vesselofruin.desc: Lowers the Sp. Atk of all opposing Pokémon.

victorystar.name: Victorystar
victorystar.shortDesc: Increases moves' accuracy to 1.1× for friendly Pokémon.
victorystar.desc: All friendly Pokémon's moves, including this Pokémon's own moves, have 1.1× their usual accuracy while this Pokémon is in battle.

voltabsorb.name: Voltabsorb
voltabsorb.shortDesc: Absorbs []{type:electric} moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.
voltabsorb.desc: Grants immunity to Electric-type moves. Heals 25% HP when hit by Electric moves.

wanderingspirit.name: Wanderingspirit
wanderingspirit.shortDesc: Swaps abilities with opponents on contact.
wanderingspirit.desc: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.

waterabsorb.name: Waterabsorb
waterabsorb.shortDesc: Absorbs []{type:water} moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.
waterabsorb.desc: Grants immunity to Water-type moves. Heals 25% HP when hit by Water moves.

waterbubble.name: Waterbubble
waterbubble.shortDesc: Halves damage from Fire moves, doubles damage of Water moves, and prevents burns.
waterbubble.desc: When this Pokémon is hit by a Fire move, the damage is halved. When this Pokémon uses a Water move, the power is doubled. This Pokémon cannot be burned, and if it becomes burned, the burn is immediately cured.

watercompaction.name: Watercompaction
watercompaction.shortDesc: Raises this Pokémon's Defense by two stages when it's hit by a Water move.
watercompaction.desc: Raises this Pokémon's Defense by two stages when it's hit by a Water move.

weakarmor.name: Weakarmor
weakarmor.shortDesc: Raises Speed and lowers Defense by one stage each upon being hit by a physical move.
weakarmor.desc: Whenever a physical move hits this Pokémon, its Speed rises one stage and its Defense falls one stage. This ability triggers on every hit of a multiple-hit move.

wellbakedbody.name: Wellbakedbody
wellbakedbody.shortDesc: The Pokémon takes no damage from Fire-type moves and sharply boosts its Defense if hit by one.
wellbakedbody.desc: The Pokémon takes no damage from Fire-type moves and sharply boosts its Defense if hit by one.

whitesmoke.name: Whitesmoke
whitesmoke.shortDesc: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.
whitesmoke.desc: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stats.

wimpout.name: Wimp Out
wimpout.shortDesc: Switches out when HP is 50% or less after taking damage.
wimpout.desc: When this Pokémon's HP falls to 50% or less from damage, it immediately attempts to switch out if a replacement is available.

windpower.name: Windpower
windpower.shortDesc: If hit by a wind move or if Tailwind begins, the Pokémon becomes charged to boost its next Electric attack.
windpower.desc: If hit by a wind move or if Tailwind begins, the Pokémon becomes charged to boost its next Electric attack.

windrider.name: Windrider
windrider.shortDesc: The Pokémon takes no damage from wind moves, and its Attack is boosted if hit by one or if Tailwind begins.
windrider.desc: The Pokémon takes no damage from wind moves, and its Attack is boosted if hit by one or if Tailwind begins.

wonderguard.name: Wonderguard
wonderguard.shortDesc: Protects against damaging moves that are not super effective.
wonderguard.desc: Only super-effective moves can hit this Pokemon.

wonderskin.name: Wonderskin
wonderskin.shortDesc: Lowers incoming non-damaging moves' base accuracy to exactly 50%.
wonderskin.desc: Non-damaging moves have exactly 50% base accuracy against this Pokémon.

zenmode.name: Zenmode
zenmode.shortDesc: Changes []{pokemon:darmanitan}'s form after each turn depending on its HP: Zen Mode below 50% max HP, and Standard Mode otherwise.
zenmode.desc: This Pokémon switches between Standard Mode and Zen Mode after each turn depending on its HP. Below 50% of its maximum HP, it switches to Zen Mode, and at 50% or above, it switches to Standard Mode. This Pokémon returns to Standard Mode upon leaving battle or losing this ability. This ability has no effect if this Pokémon is not a []{pokemon:darmanitan}.

zerotohero.name: Zerotohero
zerotohero.shortDesc: Switching out transforms the Pokémon into its Hero Form.
zerotohero.desc: Switching out transforms the Pokémon into its Hero Form.

mountaineer.name: Mountaineer
mountaineer.shortDesc: On switch-in, blocks Rock moves and Stealth Rock damage (CAP).
mountaineer.desc: When this Pokémon is switched in, it avoids damage from Stealth Rock and is immune to Rock-type moves for that switch-in turn (CAP ability).

rebound.name: Rebound
rebound.shortDesc: On switch-in, reflects the first status move that hits (CAP).
rebound.desc: After this Pokémon switches in, the first status move that would affect it or its side that turn is negated and reflected back at the user, similar to Magic Bounce (CAP ability).

persistent.name: Persistent
persistent.desc: When this Pokémon sets field effects such as Tailwind, Trick Room, Magic Room, or Wonder Room, their durations last two additional turns. Reflect, Light Screen, Safeguard, and Lucky Chant it creates also last two extra turns (CAP ability).
